author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
⚡️Gamma’s new templates are game-changers → https://gam.link/kevin_stratvert
Gamma is known for making great-looking presentations quickly and easily. But Gamma can make a presentation even better if you feed it real, relevant information from your business.

Instead of generating a presentation with placeholder information, I’ll show you my workflows that use information from my emails and documents. By leveraging real information from your business, Gamma can create presentations that are much closer to the final product, with a distinctive, polished style. 

What you’ll learn
• Generate a presentation quickly using Gamma’s AI
• Import a document to generate a presentation with your information
• Use Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or another AI tool to compile information for Gamma to use
• Connect Gamma to your AI assistant using MCP connectors
